posts.title: iPhone Duo
posts.description: I've had an iPhone Duo for about a week or so and the most striking thing about it is, it's not really a phone. You could say that iPhones never really were phones in the first place but the form-factor, the user interface and the versatility of the Duo erases any link these devices have to a telephone handset.
